# Deprecated sheets

These two schematics were removed from the project on 21 September 2026 by
`_work/rev03_drop_dead_sheets.py`. They are kept here, and in git history, for traceability.

**Do not reuse them.** They implement an architecture that is not realisable, and they have defects
of their own.

## Why they were removed

**They implement a dead architecture.** Both were generated by script for the Rev01/Rev02
architecture, which was invalidated when blocker B-01 closed: the KV260's IAS0 connector does not
reach the programmable logic — its MIPI lanes end at an AP1302 ISP on the carrier card. See
[../docs/BLOCKERS_AND_RISKS.md](../docs/BLOCKERS_AND_RISKS.md).

**They have defects of their own, independent of the architecture:**

| File | Defects |
|---|---|
| `FRONTEND.kicad_sch` | The ADL5801 mixer does not reach the 10.5 GHz it was specified for. The AD9767's AVDD sits on the 1.8 V rail, on a 3.3 V device. The ADP151 1.8 V LDO is undersized (200 mA) and would dissipate 1.6 W in a TSOT-23-5. Anti-alias filter, reconstruction filter, LNA, baluns and LO synthesiser are absent. 48 `pin_to_pin` conflicts ERC cannot interpret, because the EasyEDA symbols carry no electrical types |
| `PHASED_ARRAY.kicad_sch` | The B units of all 8 ADAR1000s, which hold the power pins, were never placed: **the chips have no power**. The 8-pin interface header the documentation described was never instantiated. Zero decoupling capacitors. `ADDR0`/`ADDR1` give 4 addresses, not the 8 claimed. Each ADAR1000 has 4 channels, so 8 chips are 32 elements, not 8 |

**And the phased array does not need designing at all.** The open
[AERIS-10 / PLFM_RADAR](https://github.com/NawfalMotii79/PLFM_RADAR) project already solves the
ADAR1000s, the T/R front ends, the mixers, the synthesisers and the array.

## Measured effect of removing them

ERC on the root schematic, with `kicad-cli 10.0.1`:

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Total violations | **1130** | **427** |
| `pin_to_pin` | 63 | **0** |
| `missing_power_pin` | 8 | **0** |
| `missing_unit` | 8 | **0** |
| `lib_symbol_mismatch` | 25 | **0** |
| `isolated_pin_label` | 26 | **0** |
| `same_local_global_label` | 13 | **0** |

What remains is pre-existing noise from the Altium import. Every serious electrical category is now
at zero.

| File | What it is |
